title: We all have heard the stock market is not the economy, but this is a seemingly paradoxical…
text: We all have heard the stock market is not the economy, but this is a seemingly paradoxical phenomenon in light of the 2 viruses infecting our current state (covid and racism).But the market is amoral and simply reinforces what is embedded in the social order (inequality).
